name: photu
//engines: Floor is 22.12, not 22: rolldown's native bindings (via vitest) declare `^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`, and below that pnpm silently skips them as unsatisfiable optional deps. See .npmrc.
//pnpm: pnpm 10 blocks postinstall scripts unless listed here. These packages ship native binaries or need a postinstall to be usable at all; anything added must be a deliberate decision, which is the point of the allowlist.
//devDependencies: Shared toolchain lives at the root only, so workspace packages cannot drift onto different compiler or test-runner versions. TypeScript is pinned to the 5.9 line deliberately: 7.x is the native Go rewrite and 6.x is a transition release, neither of which the Expo 57 / RN 0.86 type surface targets yet.
